## **Presión publicitaria** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Presión publicitaria.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona presión publicitaria.
      Ventana de reseñas: 22 ago 2026 - 22 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios notan presión publicitaria. Señala fricción de monetización y una apertura para un competidor más limpio.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _C M_, 22 ago 2026, 1/5: "DEFINITELY DO NOT RECCOMEND!!! The video ads ALL say it's a "Free" workout app, but "Surprise!" it's not AND they change the $$ amount after the 1st months $10 to $95 after with NO notice, NO refunds and it's almost impossible to cancel!!! Ignore what they say in the advertisements, NOTHING is "Free" in this app except to download it !! (even that might cost you)"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 19 ago 2026 - 21 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Melissa Audirsch_, 19 ago 2026, 1/5: "Do not download this app! It is not a real company, they will take your money, charge you a monthly subscription fee, and when you try to cancel it they will give you the run around and tell you that they can't find your account and you will not be able to cancel your subscription. STAY AWAY!!!!!"
            2. _B “Ilovetacos” R_, 21 ago 2026, 4/5: "The app itself is great. It is just too expensive for my budget. When I did have a problem figuring part of it out, Kate Brown in the support area was quick to respond, had everything I needed all in one conversation. No need for multiple back and forths. Overall it's a great app and the workouts are easy to follow, well explained and adaptable."
            3. _Karen Rosenberg_, 21 ago 2026, 5/5: "Although this program is expensive, it does help get you moving. However, because of the expense I will not be renewing my subscription. Sorry."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 13 jun 2026 - 20 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Clinton Irving_, 20 ago 2026, 1/5: "Still waiting for a response regarding the £100 they took out my account early that caused my bank to freeze my account and cost me money due to charges."
            2. _Mel_, 13 jun 2026, 1/5: "Bug d'application complète. Tentative de prélever un deuxième montant sans mon autorisation de plus de 60 euro. méfier vous. mais le pire c est que 2 mois plutard. il tente encore de vous voler des montant entre 50 et 60 euro. Pas d échéance j ai bloqué la carte. à fuire"
<!--/ir-theme-->
